title: Behaverse Mouse Recording Sample
description: Per OD-20 (resolved 2026-06-05), one sample of a mouse recording (one JSONL line). Schema 4b family member for the 'mouse' source. The captured file (typically .jsonl.gz) contains many such samples in temporal order; this schema validates each sample independently.

t.description: Seconds from recording start (float, full precision).

button_state.description: Mouse button state at sample time.
